title: PSKReporter Grid Square Repeat Rate
dataSources: FT8 spots (`ft8:spot`), JS8Call messages (`js8call:message`), PSKReporter receptions (`pskreporter:spot`), Direwolf TNC telemetry (`direwolf:packet`), and NOAA APT pass events (`noaaapt:pass`).
app: Weak-signal and decoder telemetry from WSJT-X FT8, JS8Call, PSKReporter, Direwolf TNC, NOAA APT pass schedulers, and station-control scripts sent to Splunk HEC via APIs, ADIF/log exports, and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pskreporter:spot
| search repeat_hits=*
| stats avg(repeat_hits) as avg_repeat_hits max(repeat_hits) as max_repeat_hits by grid
| sort 0 - avg_repeat_hits
description: Ranks grid squaress by repeat receptions.
value: Repeated hits from the same grids can confirm reliable paths versus one-off openings.
implementation: Send repeat receptions events to `index=personal` and keep `grid` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of repeat receptions by grid squares.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges which grid squaress stand out most for repeat receptions.
